# Description

Describe your changes in detail. If this closes an issue, link it (`closes #123`).

## Types of changes

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that changes existing behavior)
- [ ] Documentation

## Checklist

- [ ] `ruff check .` and `pytest -q` pass locally (same as CI).
- [ ] Default behavior is unchanged: paper runs still reproduce. New training-loop
      behavior is behind an off-by-default flag.
- [ ] READMEs are updated if launchers, flags, or prerequisites changed.
